name: Cornelia Hasse
original_name: コルネーリア・ハッセ
source:
An Eastern European maid who works at Arnold's main residence. Cornelia has a serious but simple personality, and seems to have come from the countryside. She is not very good at speaking Japanese.

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%A5%88%E8%90%BD%E3%81%AE%E5%9F%8E_%E4%B8%80%E6%9F%B3%E5%92%8C%E3%80%812%E5%BA%A6%E7%9B%AE%E3%81%AE%E5%8F%97%E9%9B%A3]Wikipedia[/url].]
